title: Incorrect use of "memory-safe" assembly blocks in `HookletLib.sol`
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  In `HookletLib.sol`, the `callHooklet` and `staticcallHooklet` functions do not follow the [Solidity guidelines](https://docs.soliditylang.org/en/v0.8.26/assembly.html#memory-safety) for the use of "memory-safe" assembly blocks, as the return data in case of a revert might exceed 64 bytes.  According to the Solidity documentation, "these restrictions still need to be followed, even if the assembly block reverts or terminates".  ```solidity File: Hooks.sol      function callHooklet(IHooklet self, bytes4 selector, bytes mem
